# walls.rip

> walls.rip — Anonymous communication & connectivity toolkit. Break walls for private, uncensored communication.

## What is walls.rip?

walls.rip is a suite of privacy-first communication and connectivity tools that require no identity, accounts, or personal data. All tools are designed with zero-knowledge principles — the server never sees your plaintext. Pay with Monero (XMR), Lightning Network, USDT, or XMR402.

## Tools

### Ghost Mail
Disposable encrypted email inboxes. Create temporary email addresses with optional PGP encryption. Available in three tiers:
- BASIC (free): Random address, standard domains, 30-minute session
- PREMIUM (~$1): Custom name, premium domains, extended time, PGP
- PRIVATE (~$3): Full control, all domains, max duration, PGP + extensions
Payment: Monero, Lightning, USDT (TRON/Ethereum), XMR402

### Dead Drop
Self-destructing encrypted messages using AES-256-GCM. Encryption happens entirely in the browser — the server stores only ciphertext. The decryption key lives in the URL fragment and never reaches the server. Configurable TTL: 10 minutes to 3 days.

### SMS Wall
Anonymous phone number verification. Get temporary numbers for SMS verification across 150+ countries and 1,700+ services. No identity required. Auto-refund if SMS not received. Supports long-term phone number rentals.

### Ghost Chat
End-to-end encrypted messaging over decentralized Nostr relays. PGP-encrypted, ephemeral identities, no server trust. Generate keys in-browser or import your own.

### eSIM
Anonymous eSIM data plans for 120+ countries. Country, Regional, and Global plans with 3G/4G/5G connectivity. No KYC or registration. Install via QR code. Pay with Monero, Lightning, USDT, or XMR402.

### Proxy Wall
Anonymous proxy access — residential, datacenter, and mobile proxies. SOCKS5 and HTTP protocols. Global coverage with anonymous crypto payments.

## Developer API

Full REST API available at walls.rip/api. Endpoints for SMS verification, eSIM purchases, proxy access, and dead drops. No API keys needed — wallet tokens serve as authentication. JSON responses.

### API Base URLs
- SMS/eSIM/Proxy/Dead Drop: https://api.kyc.rip/v1/tools/
- Ghost Mail: https://mail-api.kyc.rip/

### Key SMS Endpoints
- GET /sms/countries — List countries
- GET /sms/services — List services
- GET /sms/price?country=X&service=Y — Check price
- POST /sms/purchase — Buy number
- GET /sms/check?order_id=X&token=X — Poll for SMS

### Key eSIM Endpoints
- GET /esim/countries — List countries
- GET /esim/plans?country=X — List data plans
- POST /esim/purchase — Buy eSIM
- GET /esim/profile?order_id=X — Get QR code

### Payment Flow
1. POST /sms/payment/create — Create XMR or Lightning payment
2. GET /sms/payment/check?paymentId=X — Poll until paid
3. Wallet credited, use for purchases across SMS, eSIM, Proxy

## Privacy Principles

- Zero Identity: No accounts, emails, or phone numbers required
- Client-Side Crypto: Encryption in the browser, server never sees plaintext
- No Logs: No IP logging, no user-agent storage, no analytics
- Crypto Payments: Monero (XMR), Lightning, USDT (TRON/Ethereum), XMR402
- Push Notifications: Browser-only, no server-side tracking
